Registration name: Only You (hybrid tea, Vahldiek-Bissingen 1970)
Exhibition name: Only You
rows.Origin: Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1970 as 'Only You'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.75". Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form.
rows.Notes: Discovered by Vahldiek-Bissingen in 1971. Information to be added later, when possible.
